{{Top|leg}}
'''Triple blasters''' were an archaic variant of [[Blaster/Legends|Blasters]], evolved from the even older "[[Beam tube/Legends|beam tubes]]." They dated back to the earlier days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and were among the oldest designs of effective energy weapons. It worked by using three separate blaster units connected to the same targeting system, often found in coordinated sets of two or four, to fire simultaneously on a target. No company continued to mass produce them because of their cumbersome nature and outdated design, and by the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], triple blasters became exceedingly rare. However, they were a standard armament on early models of the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]].

Other than its similarities, it is unknown how else it is related to the [[TriShot]].
